text: Khanh Hoa targets $17b in new investment by 2030
Central Khanh Hoa province's People's Committee has approved an investment promotion program for 2027, outlining plans to attract investors in key sectors of the digital and green economies.
In the first half of 2027, the province will conduct a comprehensive review and update its project portfolio in line with new planning frameworks.
Priority will be given to leading corporations in semiconductors, artificial intelligence (AI), data centres, international finance, biotechnology, clean energy, logistics and seaports.
The province will also step up dialogue with businesses and organise sector-specific investment promotion events.
A business dialogue conference focusing on industrial park infrastructure and investment in Van Phong is scheduled for the second quarter of 2027.

A larger conference on seaports, logistics and industry in the Van Phong Economic Zone is planned for the fourth quarter of next year, aiming to connect the province directly with global port operators.
Provincial leaders will head investment and trade promotion delegations to key international markets to meet local authorities and multinational corporations in technology, energy and finance.

Alongside developing a dedicated investment website and expanding digital communications, Khanh Hoa aims to improve its business environment and competitiveness indicators, including PCI, PGI, PAR INDEX, SIPAS and DDCI.

The program, together with the completion of the urban master plan to 2050 and progress on establishing the Van Phong Economic Zone, is intended to support the province's target of attracting at least VND450 trillion ($17.1 billion) in newly registered investment during 2026-2030.
